config.dsh-tui-vscode.command.descriptio: Command / executable that launches dsh-TUI. On Windows this is resolved through PATH (dsh-tui.cmd), or set it to an absolute path.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.extraArgs.descript: Extra CLI arguments appended to every dsh-tui launch, e.g. ["--lang", "en"].
config.dsh-tui-vscode.terminalLocation.d: Where a new dsh-tui session terminal opens.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.lang.description: Sets DSH_TUI_LANG for the dsh-tui process.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.imageProtocol.desc: Terminal image protocol for dsh-tui sessions (exported as DSH_TUI_IMAGE_PROTOCOL). sixel (default): real raster images (artwork, photos, image previews) while VS Code terminal image rendering is on, i.e. terminal.integrated.enableImages is true and the window has been reloaded; if that setting is false, the default degrades to half-block character art so the image area stays visible instead of going blank. none: always use half-block character art. auto: export nothing and let dsh-tui decide on its own (escape hatch for when upstream protocol detection is fixed).
config.dsh-tui-vscode.injectEditor.descr: When $VISUAL/$EDITOR are unset, export VISUAL=<editorCommand> so the TUI's Ctrl+X external editor opens in VS Code.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.editorCommand.desc: Value exported as $VISUAL when dsh-tui-vscode.injectEditor is on and no VISUAL/EDITOR exists. Use the VS Code CLI with -w to wait for the file to close.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.dshHome.descriptio: Optional $DSH_HOME override for the dsh-tui session ('' keeps the value inherited from the VS Code process).
Push the selected code to the running dsh-TUI whenever the selection changes (IDE selection channel, 300ms debounce; dsh-TUI appends the selection on submit and shows `⧉ N lines selected` below the input box in real time). Requires a dsh-TUI version with the IDE selection channel (protocol v2); when the channel is unavailable, it falls back to typing `@relative/path#Lstart-end` into the running dsh-tui input box. Enabled by default to match the official Claude Code selection experience.
config.dsh-tui-vscode.terminalLocation.e: Open the session terminal in the central editor area, in a new column beside the active one (historical behavior).
Open the session terminal in the currently active editor column.
Open the session terminal in the bottom panel, next to ordinary terminals.
Do not set DSH_TUI_LANG; dsh-tui uses its own default (Chinese).
config.dsh-tui-vscode.imageProtocol.enum: Export no protocol value; dsh-tui decides on its own. Kept as the opt-out path for when upstream protocol detection is fixed.

Pin the Sixel protocol: real raster images when terminal.integrated.enableImages is true (reload the window after enabling it) and terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration is auto or on, half-block character art otherwise. Default.
Never use raster images; always render half-block character art. Pick this for text-only output.
